metadata.experiment_status: not rerun; static prompt review only

static_findings: Verifier supports partially_supported in schema and unit tests, so class collapse is not a parser/mapping bug.
The full-text and abstract prompts both instruct the model to err toward not_addressed when evidence is insufficient or off-topic.
SciFact maps partially_supported to supported and is verifier-only, so it does not validate the real four-class abstention behavior.
Unsupported requires explicit contradiction; unsupported-by-absence claims such as lactate_review_001/012/019 are structurally likely to become not_addressed.
